test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I __had get back from __Hyderabad last month.
solution:
The correct answer is:** got back from.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rule is:** Present Perfect + Point of Time= Simple Past.**
 
• It should be noted that the **point of time** (last month) in the past demonstrates that the action took place at a point in the past.
 
• So, the **verb** that must be used should be in the **simple past tense**.
 
• The point of time in the past is mentioned by the following as given below:
 
 
• ago
 
• before
 
• yesterday
 
• the other day
 
• last month/year/day
 
 
 
• The use of 'had get back from' is grammatically incorrect as the point of time is present in the sentence.
 
• Thus, 'got back from' is the correct usage in this context.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is: I ***got back from*** __Hyderabad last month.
